# Stat: `jl-stat`

A key figure with its label, its change and a sparkline of recent values.

- Class `JlStat`, a molecule: `import { JlStat } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/stat

A stat shows one key figure: what it measures, its value, how it moved and, if given, a sparkline of
its recent points. It has no frame of its own: put it in a card for a tile, and several cards in a row for a
dashboard.

The delta is coloured by its trend: up in green, down in red, flat in grey. The trend comes from the delta's sign
unless trend says otherwise; invert swaps the colours for figures where down is good, such as costs or errors.

## Use

```ts
import { JlStat } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlStat
  caption="vs. last month"
  delta="+12.5%"
  icon="credit-card"
  label="Revenue"
  points={[31,34,33,38,36,41,44,43,48]}
  value="$48,210"
/>
```

```html
<jl-stat
  caption="vs. last month"
  delta="+12.5%"
  icon="credit-card"
  label="Revenue"
  points='[31,34,33,38,36,41,44,43,48]'
  value="$48,210"
></jl-stat>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. What the figure measures.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The figure, as people read it: "$48,210", "98.2%".
- `delta` (attribute `delta`): `string`, default `''`. How it changed: "+12.5%", "-3". Its sign gives the trend.
- `trend` (attribute `trend`): `'' | 'up' | 'down' | 'flat'`, default `''`. Which way it went, when the delta's sign does not say it.
- `invert` (attribute `invert`): `boolean`, default `false`. Down is good: down in green, up in red.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon beside the label.
- `tone` (attribute `tone`): `'neutral' | 'accent' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'info'`, default `'neutral'`. The colour of the icon: quiet by default, or what the figure is about.
- `caption` (attribute `caption`): `string`, default `''`. A note under the figure.
- `points` (attribute `points`): `number[]`, default `[]`. Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The stat.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A figure

```html
<jl-stat label="Revenue" value="$48,210" delta="+12.5%" caption="vs. last month"></jl-stat>
```

### A row of stats

Tiles in cards, side by side: the dashboard row.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: stretch">
  <jl-card style="flex: 1 1 200px">
    <jl-stat label="Revenue" icon="credit-card" value="$48,210" delta="+12.5%" caption="vs. last month" points='[31, 34, 33, 38, 36, 41, 44, 43, 48]'></jl-stat>
  </jl-card>
  <jl-card style="flex: 1 1 200px">
    <jl-stat label="Sign-ups" icon="users" value="1,204" delta="+8.1%" caption="vs. last month" points='[120, 132, 128, 141, 150, 147, 162, 170, 168, 181]'></jl-stat>
  </jl-card>
  <jl-card style="flex: 1 1 200px">
    <jl-stat label="Churn" icon="log-out" value="2.4%" delta="-0.7 pt" invert caption="vs. last month" points='[3.1, 3.0, 2.8, 2.9, 2.6, 2.5, 2.4]'></jl-stat>
  </jl-card>
</div>
```

### Coloured icons

tone colours the icon, for what the figure is about.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-stat label="Runs today" icon="zap" value="128" tone="info"></jl-stat>
  <jl-stat label="Approved" icon="circle-check" value="96%" tone="ok"></jl-stat>
  <jl-stat label="Waiting" icon="clock" value="5" tone="warn"></jl-stat>
</div>
```

### Trends

Down in red; invert for figures where down is good; flat in grey.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: flex-start; gap: 40px">
  <jl-stat label="Active users" value="8,912" delta="-3.2%"></jl-stat>
  <jl-stat label="Load time" value="1.2 s" delta="-0.3 s" invert></jl-stat>
  <jl-stat label="Error rate" value="0.8%" delta="+0.2 pt" invert></jl-stat>
  <jl-stat label="Open tickets" value="42" delta="0" ></jl-stat>
</div>
```

### Sparkline

The sparkline alone says the direction, when the exact change matters less.

```html
<jl-card class="narrow">
  <jl-stat label="Requests per minute" value="3,480" caption="Last 24 hours" points="[12, 18, 15, 22, 30, 26, 34, 41, 38, 46, 44, 52]"></jl-stat>
</jl-card>
```
